judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly, and all measured checks passed. It adds 18 µL master mix, then 1 µL template with a 3x mix and 1 µL primer to each of the 96 wells with fresh tips, and it records the seal and thermocycling in a comment. I found no deviations from the task, so every item scores 1.
